market_summary: Quiet weekend; US prices unchanged from Friday's close, when chips fell 7.2% after Intel's 28.6% drop and the Nasdaq lost 2.9%. China's October factory PMI fell to 49.3. BYD's October sales rose 11% on a year ago, with overseas sales doubling. No confirmation yet of a Marvell-Lumentum deal or an OpenAI round close. Next, AEDT: Apple results 9am Tue; RBA 2:30pm Tue; Astera, AMD and Supermicro Wed morning; US jobs 12:30am Sat.

AMZN.reason: -1.4% Fri, -3.1% week. AWS +39% but trailing free cash flow turned negative on AI spend; market punished capex, not demand.

AXOS.reason: -2.3% Fri, -1.5% week. No company news found; drifted with the broad selloff.

BABA.reason: -1.5% Fri, -1.6% week. No new catalyst found; moved with the tech tape.

ENPH.reason: -0.8% Fri, -18.8% week after the Q3 miss and Q4 guide roughly 20% below estimates (-16% on Wed). Six-year lows; thesis now rests on new products.

FIGR.reason: -8.5% Fri, -6.9% week. No specific news found; high-beta name hit hardest in the risk-off day.

GOOGL.reason: -1.4% Fri, -12.6% week. Worst day since 2004 on Thursday after an EPS miss, higher capex guidance and negative free cash flow. Cloud +103% keeps the thesis intact.

LDI.reason: -3.2% Fri, -4.9% week. No news found; stays a small speculative position.

META.reason: -1.5% Fri, -4.3% week. Held up better than chips despite AI capex worries.

MRVL.reason: -10.1% Fri, -14.1% week. Reported all-stock Lumentum deal, small premium, could be announced next week; dilution fear. Not confirmed yet.

MU.reason: -5.3% Fri, +0.8% week. Chip index -7.2% Fri on Intel; high memory prices blamed for PC weakness, which still favours Micron's pricing.

NFLX.reason: +0.1% Fri, -5.7% week. Defensive on Friday; no new news found.

NVDA.reason: -4.2% Fri, -3.0% week. Fell in the Intel-led chip rout (chip index -7.2%), not on own news.

RKT.reason: +7.4% Fri, +9.1% week. Only green holding; reports cite a Q3 beat (released Oct 29), not independently confirmed.

TSM.reason: -6.0% Fri, -3.0% week. Sold off with the chip index on AI-spend doubts; no company-specific news.

STRIPE.reason: No new priced round or tender found this period.

OPENAI.reason: No new closed round found since the March close; nothing over the weekend.

headlines: Quiet weekend: US prices unchanged since Friday's 7.2% chip sell-off.
BYD October sales up 11% to 490,168; overseas sales doubled on a year ago.
Marvell-Lumentum and OpenAI's round still unconfirmed; Lumentum reports Nov 5.
Next, AEDT: Apple results 9am Tue, RBA 2:30pm Tue, AMD and Astera Wed morning, US jobs early Sat.
